title: Cloud, Containers, Kubernetes & Platform Engineering
summary: Operate software on modern infrastructure from failure domains and networking through containers, CI/CD, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and internal platforms.

modules.title: Cloud primitives, failure domains & shared responsibility
modules.summary: Understand regions, zones, managed services and responsibility boundaries before vendor service memorization.
modules.why: Good cloud architecture is mostly about failure domains, identity, networking, managed-state choices and operational ownership.

units.title: Regions, zones & failure-domain design
units.summary: Place redundant components so one infrastructure fault does not remove every copy.
units.challenge: Place web/app/database components for zone failure and explain remaining regional risks.
units.evidence: Deployment topology with explicit failure assumptions.

units.title: Managed services vs self-hosting
units.summary: Trade control and portability against operational burden and platform integration.
units.challenge: Choose managed/self-hosted options for PostgreSQL, Kafka and Kubernetes for three team sizes.

units.title: Shared responsibility, quotas & account/project structure
units.summary: Understand what the cloud secures and what your team must configure/operate.
units.challenge: Identify which failures/security controls are yours vs provider's for a sample architecture.
units.evidence: Responsibility matrix and critical quota inventory.

modules.title: VPC/VNet, subnets, routing & egress
modules.summary: Map network fundamentals into cloud virtual networks and security boundaries.
modules.why: Many cloud incidents are route, NAT, DNS or security-rule mistakes rather than application bugs.

units.title: VPCs, subnets & route tables
units.summary: Design address spaces and packet paths inside cloud networks.
units.challenge: Create a network for public ingress, private app/data tiers and admin access.
units.evidence: Network diagram with every route explained.

units.title: NAT, egress & private service access
units.summary: Control outbound connectivity without exposing private workloads inbound.
units.challenge: Allow private app instances to reach package/vendor APIs while DB remains non-internet-routable.

units.title: Security groups, network ACLs & segmentation
units.summary: Apply least-privilege network reachability as an additional boundary.
units.challenge: Reduce a flat allow-all network policy to required service flows only.

modules.title: VMs, autoscaling & serverless compute
modules.summary: Choose compute models based on workload lifecycle, isolation, startup and operational constraints.
modules.why: Compute choice determines deployment model, scaling mechanics and cost shape.

units.title: Virtual machines, images & instance lifecycle
units.summary: Operate long-lived compute with immutable or configured images.
units.challenge: Design immutable replacement rather than in-place configuration drift for app VMs.

units.title: Autoscaling groups & health replacement
units.summary: Scale replicated compute from demand and replace unhealthy instances.
units.challenge: Scale a stateless service on load while avoiding oscillation.

units.title: Functions/serverless architecture
units.summary: Use event-driven managed compute while understanding cold starts, limits and state boundaries.
units.challenge: Evaluate scheduled thumbnail generation on VM, container worker and serverless function.

modules.title: Load balancing, DNS, CDN & edge architecture
modules.summary: Route external traffic safely and efficiently from global edge to healthy services.
modules.why: Availability and latency depend heavily on traffic management before requests reach application code.

units.title: L4 vs L7 load balancing
units.summary: Choose traffic distribution based on transport/application awareness.
units.challenge: Design load balancing for HTTP APIs and raw TCP service and explain health semantics.

units.title: DNS & global traffic steering
units.summary: Route clients across regions while accounting for TTL/caching and health signals.
units.challenge: Design global routing with controlled regional evacuation.

units.title: CDNs & edge caching
units.summary: Cache public/static/cacheable dynamic content near users without serving incorrect variants.
units.challenge: Design CDN caching for assets and downloadable tenant files with auth boundaries.

modules.title: Cloud storage & managed data services
modules.summary: Map block, object, file and managed database primitives to workload requirements.
modules.why: Storage durability, access pattern and attachment semantics vary dramatically across cloud storage types.

units.title: Block, file & object storage
units.summary: Choose persistence primitives by attachment, sharing and object semantics.
units.challenge: Choose storage for DB volume, shared build assets, user files and analytics archive.

units.title: Managed relational databases
units.summary: Understand managed backups, replicas, patching and failover boundaries.
units.challenge: Design a production managed DB topology and maintenance/failover plan.

units.title: Managed NoSQL, queue & event services
units.summary: Use cloud-managed primitives while retaining correct distributed-systems reasoning.
units.challenge: Replace self-hosted components in one architecture with managed services and identify semantic differences.

modules.title: Containers, images & Docker
modules.summary: Understand process isolation and reproducible packaging rather than treating containers as mini-VMs.
modules.why: Container behaviour around PID 1, signals, filesystems and limits directly affects production reliability.

units.title: Namespaces, cgroups & container isolation
units.summary: Understand the Linux primitives behind containers.
units.challenge: Inspect a container's process/network/resource view from host and inside container.

units.title: Dockerfiles, layers & image construction
units.summary: Build small reproducible images with cache-aware layers.
units.challenge: Reduce a bloated Java image and pin reproducible dependencies/base digest.

units.title: PID 1, signals, filesystem & lifecycle
units.summary: Make applications shut down, persist data and log correctly inside containers.
units.challenge: Kill/stop a container under active requests and verify graceful drain.
units.evidence: Shutdown trace and persisted-vs-ephemeral data map.

modules.title: Continuous integration & build pipelines
modules.summary: Turn every change into a reproducible build, test and security signal.
modules.why: CI is the enforcement point for code quality, dependency trust and deployable artifact creation.

units.title: Build/test/package pipeline architecture
units.summary: Separate source validation from immutable artifact production.
units.challenge: Build CI for Java+React+integration dependencies with parallel safe stages.

units.title: CI environments, permissions & secrets
units.summary: Minimize credentials and separate untrusted build from privileged deployment.
units.challenge: Threat-model CI and remove long-lived deployment credentials.

units.title: Reproducibility, provenance & artifact promotion
units.summary: Build once, promote the same verified artifact through environments.
units.challenge: Design staging/prod promotion with signed artifact and no prod rebuild.
units.evidence: Release artifact chain and verification gates.

modules.title: CD, progressive delivery & release safety
modules.summary: Deploy changes incrementally with observability, rollback and compatibility controls.
modules.why: Deployment strategy is a runtime risk-control mechanism, not just automation.

units.title: Rolling, blue-green & immutable deployments
units.summary: Understand version coexistence and traffic-switch implications.
units.challenge: Deploy a breaking internal change safely across old/new app versions.

units.title: Canary & progressive delivery
units.summary: Expose small traffic cohorts and automate promotion/rollback from signals.
units.challenge: Define a canary plan for a latency-sensitive change with error/latency/business guardrails.
units.evidence: Promotion policy and simulated decision results.

units.title: Feature flags, dark launches & rollback
units.summary: Separate code deployment from feature exposure without accumulating permanent flag debt.
units.challenge: Launch a risky search backend behind dark traffic then staged exposure.
units.evidence: Release plan and flag cleanup criteria.

modules.title: Infrastructure as Code & policy
modules.summary: Make infrastructure changes versioned, reviewable, reproducible and drift-detectable.
modules.why: Manual cloud configuration becomes invisible technical debt and disaster-recovery risk.

units.title: Declarative desired state & Terraform state
units.summary: Understand resource graph/state reconciliation and plan/apply lifecycle.
units.challenge: Provision a small environment, make manual drift, detect and reconcile it.
units.evidence: Plan output and drift recovery explanation.

units.title: Modules, environments & remote state
units.summary: Reuse infrastructure without coupling every environment/team to one giant state file.
units.challenge: Design reusable network/service modules across dev/stage/prod.

units.title: Policy as code & infrastructure guardrails
units.summary: Prevent unsafe infrastructure while allowing team self-service.
units.challenge: Define guardrails that block public databases and unencrypted storage while allowing reviewed exception.

modules.title: Kubernetes object model & reconciliation
modules.summary: Understand Kubernetes as declarative control loops over desired state.
modules.why: Memorizing kubectl commands without control-plane/reconciliation mental models makes debugging difficult.

units.title: Pods, ReplicaSets & Deployments
units.summary: Understand scheduling unit, replication and rollout controllers.
units.challenge: Deploy a service and observe controller replacement after deleting pods.

units.title: Services, ConfigMaps & Secrets
units.summary: Provide stable service identity and externalized configuration to ephemeral pods.
units.challenge: Run two service versions and inspect DNS/service endpoint changes.

units.title: API server, etcd & reconciliation loops
units.summary: Understand desired/current state and controller behaviour.
units.challenge: Trace a Deployment create request through objects/controllers until Pods run.

modules.title: Kubernetes scheduling & resource management
modules.summary: Place workloads and protect cluster stability with requests/limits and scheduling constraints.
modules.why: Incorrect requests/limits lead to poor placement, throttling and noisy-neighbor failure.

units.title: CPU/memory requests, limits & QoS
units.summary: Understand scheduler reservation and runtime enforcement.
units.challenge: Run under/over-sized workloads and observe scheduling/throttling/OOM behaviour.
units.evidence: Resource settings tied to measured workload usage.

units.title: Scheduler, affinity, taints & topology
units.summary: Influence workload placement for reliability and hardware/locality needs.
units.challenge: Spread replicas across zones while dedicating special nodes to one workload.

units.title: Disruption budgets & capacity planning
units.summary: Preserve availability during voluntary maintenance and rolling changes.
units.challenge: Design maintenance that drains a node pool without violating service SLO.

modules.title: Kubernetes networking, ingress & traffic
modules.summary: Understand pod/service routing, ingress and network policy.
modules.why: Kubernetes networking layers add virtual endpoints/proxies/rules that must be debugged systematically.

units.title: Pod networking & Service routing
units.summary: Follow packets from client/service name to changing pod endpoints.
units.challenge: Trace a request from one pod to a service to backing pod and diagnose a broken selector.

units.title: Ingress/Gateway API & TLS termination
units.summary: Expose HTTP services through shared routing infrastructure.
units.challenge: Route multiple hosts/paths to services with TLS and observe controller-generated infrastructure.

units.title: NetworkPolicy & east-west segmentation
units.summary: Restrict pod communication beyond default open cluster networking.
units.challenge: Allow frontend→API→DB only and prove forbidden lateral communication fails.

modules.title: Kubernetes storage & stateful workloads
modules.summary: Understand persistent volumes, stateful identity and when databases do not belong in your cluster.
modules.why: Stateful systems have ownership/failover semantics that Kubernetes cannot make trivial.

units.title: PersistentVolumes, claims & storage classes
units.summary: Understand dynamic storage provisioning and attachment lifecycle.
units.challenge: Persist application data across pod replacement and inspect volume lifecycle.

units.title: StatefulSets & stable identity
units.summary: Provide ordered/stable pod names and per-replica storage when applications require identity.
units.challenge: Deploy a simple replicated stateful demo and observe restart/identity behaviour.

units.title: Database-on-Kubernetes trade-offs & operators
units.summary: Evaluate self-managed stateful operators against managed database services.
units.challenge: Write an ADR for PostgreSQL on Kubernetes vs managed PostgreSQL.

modules.title: Kubernetes security & multi-tenancy
modules.summary: Secure API access, workloads, images and namespace/network boundaries.
modules.why: A cluster is a high-value control plane; default convenience can create broad lateral privilege.

units.title: RBAC, service accounts & workload credentials
units.summary: Grant humans/workloads minimum Kubernetes API privileges.
units.challenge: Create least-privilege deployment/read-only/operator roles and test forbidden actions.
units.evidence: Permission matrix and kubectl authorization tests.

units.title: Pod security & runtime hardening
units.summary: Reduce container privilege and host attack surface.
units.challenge: Harden a permissive workload until it passes a restricted policy baseline.
units.evidence: Security context before/after and blocked-privilege tests.

units.title: Cluster multi-tenancy & isolation boundaries
units.summary: Decide when namespace isolation is sufficient and when separate clusters/accounts are safer.
units.challenge: Design tenant/team isolation for internal platform vs untrusted customer workloads.
units.evidence: Isolation decision matrix and threat model.

modules.title: Kubernetes autoscaling & workload elasticity
modules.summary: Scale pods/nodes from demand while respecting startup, queues and downstream bottlenecks.
modules.why: Autoscaling can amplify bottlenecks if the metric does not represent constrained capacity.

units.title: Horizontal Pod Autoscaling & metrics
units.summary: Scale replica count from CPU/custom demand signals.
units.challenge: Scale a service using CPU and then request-rate/queue metric; compare behaviour.

units.title: Vertical rightsizing concepts
units.summary: Adjust requests/limits from observed workload demand.
units.challenge: Right-size a Java workload from measured CPU/memory percentiles.

units.title: Node/cluster autoscaling & pending workloads
units.summary: Add/remove infrastructure based on unschedulable workload and utilization.
units.challenge: Design sudden traffic scaling where pod demand exceeds current cluster capacity.
units.evidence: End-to-end scaling timeline including node startup.

modules.title: Proxies, service mesh & east-west traffic
modules.summary: Understand sidecar/ambient proxy patterns before adding a mesh.
modules.why: Service meshes centralize transport security/traffic policy but add control-plane and debugging complexity.

units.title: Proxy data plane & sidecar concepts
units.summary: Understand interception, routing and telemetry in the request path.
units.challenge: Trace an app-to-app request with and without sidecar proxy.
units.evidence: Layered request path and duplicated timeout/retry risks.

units.title: Mesh control plane, mTLS & policy
units.summary: Distribute identity, certificates and routing policy to proxies.
units.challenge: Design zero-trust service communication with mesh-managed workload certificates.

units.title: When not to use a service mesh
units.summary: Evaluate complexity, ownership and simpler gateway/library alternatives.
units.challenge: Evaluate mesh adoption for 8-service and 500-service organizations.
units.evidence: Adoption ADR with prerequisites and exit criteria.

modules.title: Internal platforms, golden paths & developer experience
modules.summary: Design self-service infrastructure that reduces cognitive load while preserving team ownership.
modules.why: Platforms should make the safe path easy, not become a central ticket queue.

units.title: Platform as product & developer personas
units.summary: Treat internal developers as users with measured friction and outcomes.
units.challenge: Interview/simulate developer needs and define a platform product charter.
units.evidence: Platform problem statement with success metrics.

units.title: Golden paths, templates & self-service
units.summary: Encode common service creation/deployment practices behind APIs/templates.
units.challenge: Design one-click service creation including repo, CI, infra, observability and ownership.

units.title: Service catalog, ownership & scorecards
units.summary: Make service metadata, health and standards discoverable.
units.challenge: Define metadata and scorecards for reliability/security/maintainability across 100 services.

modules.title: Cloud cost engineering & FinOps
modules.summary: Treat cost as a measurable quality attribute and design constraint.
modules.why: Architecture determines compute/storage/network unit economics long before finance reports the bill.

units.title: Unit economics & cost allocation
units.summary: Relate infrastructure spend to users, requests, tenants or business output.
units.challenge: Calculate cost per active tenant/request for the capstone.

units.title: Rightsizing, utilization & commitment models
units.summary: Reduce waste while preserving reliability headroom.
units.challenge: Optimize compute cost using measured utilization without violating SLO capacity.
units.evidence: Before/after monthly cost and risk analysis.

units.title: Data transfer, storage tiers & architecture cost traps
units.summary: Recognize egress, replication and retained data as major architecture cost drivers.
units.challenge: Redesign a chat/media architecture to reduce cross-region/egress/storage spend.
units.evidence: Cost-driver Pareto analysis and architecture changes.
